export const categoriesRelations = drizzleRelations(categories, ({ one, many }) => ({
    "products": many(products, { relationName: "products_categoryId" })
}));

export const customersRelations = drizzleRelations(customers, ({ one, many }) => ({
    "orders": many(orders, { relationName: "orders_customerId" }),
    "customer_demographics": many(customerCustomerDemo, { relationName: "customer_demographics" })
}));

export const customerCustomerDemoRelations = drizzleRelations(customerCustomerDemo, ({ one, many }) => ({
    "customer_id": one(customers, {
        fields: [customerCustomerDemo.customer_id],
        references: [customers.customerId],
        relationName: "customer_demographics"
    }),
    "customer_type_id": one(customerDemographics, {
        fields: [customerCustomerDemo.customer_type_id],
        references: [customerDemographics.customerTypeId],
        relationName: "customer_customer_demo_customer_type_id"
    })
}));

export const employeesRelations = drizzleRelations(employees, ({ one, many }) => ({
    "employees": many(employees, { relationName: "employees_reportsTo" }),
    "orders": many(orders, { relationName: "orders_employeeId" }),
    "territories": many(employeeTerritories, { relationName: "territories" }),
    "reportsTo": one(employees, {
        fields: [employees.reportsTo],
        references: [employees.employeeId],
        relationName: "employees_reportsTo"
    })
}));

export const employeeTerritoriesRelations = drizzleRelations(employeeTerritories, ({ one, many }) => ({
    "employee_id": one(employees, {
        fields: [employeeTerritories.employee_id],
        references: [employees.employeeId],
        relationName: "territories"
    }),
    "territory_id": one(territories, {
        fields: [employeeTerritories.territory_id],
        references: [territories.territoryId],
        relationName: "employees"
    })
}));

export const orderDetailsRelations = drizzleRelations(orderDetails, ({ one, many }) => ({
    "order": one(orders, {
        fields: [orderDetails.orderId],
        references: [orders.orderId],
        relationName: "order_details_orderId"
    }),
    "product": one(products, {
        fields: [orderDetails.productId],
        references: [products.productId],
        relationName: "order_details_productId"
    })
}));

export const ordersRelations = drizzleRelations(orders, ({ one, many }) => ({
    "order_details": many(orderDetails, { relationName: "order_details_orderId" }),
    "customer": one(customers, {
        fields: [orders.customerId],
        references: [customers.customerId],
        relationName: "orders_customerId"
    }),
    "employee": one(employees, {
        fields: [orders.employeeId],
        references: [employees.employeeId],
        relationName: "orders_employeeId"
    }),
    "shipVia": one(shippers, {
        fields: [orders.shipVia],
        references: [shippers.shipperId],
        relationName: "orders_shipVia"
    })
}));

export const productsRelations = drizzleRelations(products, ({ one, many }) => ({
    "order_details": many(orderDetails, { relationName: "order_details_productId" }),
    "category": one(categories, {
        fields: [products.categoryId],
        references: [categories.categoryId],
        relationName: "products_categoryId"
    }),
    "supplier": one(suppliers, {
        fields: [products.supplierId],
        references: [suppliers.supplierId],
        relationName: "products_supplierId"
    })
}));

export const regionRelations = drizzleRelations(region, ({ one, many }) => ({
    "territories": many(territories, { relationName: "territories_regionId" })
}));

export const shippersRelations = drizzleRelations(shippers, ({ one, many }) => ({
    "orders": many(orders, { relationName: "orders_shipVia" })
}));

export const suppliersRelations = drizzleRelations(suppliers, ({ one, many }) => ({
    "products": many(products, { relationName: "products_supplierId" })
}));

export const territoriesRelations = drizzleRelations(territories, ({ one, many }) => ({
    "employees": many(employeeTerritories, { relationName: "employees" }),
    "region": one(region, {
        fields: [territories.regionId],
        references: [region.regionId],
        relationName: "territories_regionId"
    })
}));

export const tables = { categories, customerDemographics, customers, customerCustomerDemo, employees, employeeTerritories, orderDetails, orders, products, region, shippers, suppliers, territories, usStates };
export const enums = {  };
export const relations = { categoriesRelations, customersRelations, customerCustomerDemoRelations, employeesRelations, employeeTerritoriesRelations, orderDetailsRelations, ordersRelations, productsRelations, regionRelations, shippersRelations, suppliersRelations, territoriesRelations };
